## Description {#details}

<p>A variadic template argument.</p>


<p>This node represents an occurrence of J&lt;something&gt;E in some &lt;template-args&gt;. It isn't itself unexpanded, unless one of its Elements is. The parser inserts a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/parameterpack">ParameterPack</a> into the TemplateParams table if the &lt;template-args&gt; this pack belongs to apply to an &lt;encoding&gt;.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1463 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/demangle/itaniumdemangle-h">ItaniumDemangle.h</a>.</p>
